name: qualify-vscode
description: Qualification tests (IQ, OQ, PQ, intended use) in the VS Code Testing view, grouped by product, package and level, with results from the qualify evidence records.
author: Tobias Lekman

qualify.enabled.markdownDescription: Whether the extension reads this folder. Set it to `false` in a folder's `.vscode/settings.json` to leave that folder's tests out of the Testing view.

qualify.evidenceDir.markdownDescription: Where the tests write their evidence, relative to the package folder. The extension sets `QUALIFY_EVIDENCE_DIR` to this folder for every run, and reads the records from it afterwards.

qualify.runners.markdownDescription: Command per runner for every package, keyed by runner ID (`vitest`, `node-test`, `bun-test`, `pytest`, `gradle`, `maven`, `dotnet`, `cucumber-js`). Placeholders: `${tool}`, `${filter}`, `${id}`, `${ids}`, `${package}`, `${evidenceDir}`, `${workspaceFolder}`.

qualify.packages.markdownDescription: Settings per package, keyed by the package folder relative to the workspace folder (`.` for the folder itself). Each takes `command` (for every runner in the package), `runners` (a command per runner ID) and `evidenceDir`. For example `{ "apps/web": { "command": "task test:intended-use -- ${ids}" } }`.

command.description: The command for every runner in this package.

evidenceDir.description: Where this package's tests write their evidence, relative to the package folder.

qualify.exclude.markdownDescription: Globs, relative to the workspace folder, that discovery skips as well as the built-in ones: `**/node_modules/**`, `**/dist/**`, `**/build/**`, `**/bin/**`, `**/obj/**`, `**/target/**`, `**/.venv/**`, `**/.git/**`, `**/.vscode-test/**`, `**/conformance/**`, `**/fixture/**`, `**/fixtures/**` and `**/test-host/**`. Start a built-in glob with `!` to read that folder again, such as `!**/conformance/**`. `["**"]` skips the whole folder.

qualify.useGitIgnore.markdownDescription: Whether discovery also skips what each `.gitignore` in the folder ignores. Lines that start with `!` are not read.

qualify.traceFiles.markdownDescription: Where `Qualify: Open Trace Matrix` looks for the output of `qualify trace`.

scripts.test:host: bun run build && bun run scripts/build-host-test.ts && bun run test-host/run.ts
scripts.package: bun run build && bun run scripts/package.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
